title: Gayatri Mantra Meaning: A Simple Word-by-Word Explanation
intro: The Gayatri Mantra is among the most chanted verses in Hinduism. It is just a few lines long, but each word has a clear meaning.

p: Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah | Tat Savitur Varenyam | Bhargo Devasya Dhimahi | Dhiyo Yo Nah Prachodayat ||
It is found in the Rig Veda and is addressed to Savitr, the sun as a source of light.
Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah: Om, the earth, the atmosphere and the heavens, meaning all the worlds.
Tat Savitur Varenyam: that most adorable light of Savitr, the sun.
Bhargo Devasya Dhimahi: we meditate on the radiance of that divine being.
Dhiyo Yo Nah Prachodayat: may it inspire and guide our intellect.
It does not ask for wealth or favours. It asks for clear thinking, which is why students and professionals chant it.
Sunrise is traditionally the best time, but any quiet time works. Sit comfortably, breathe slowly and repeat it eleven or 108 times.

faq.q: Can anyone chant the Gayatri Mantra?
faq.a: Traditions vary, but many families and teachers encourage everyone to chant it with respect and understanding.
Sunrise, noon and sunset are the traditional times.
